channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2025-57819 — Sangoma FreePBX
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Sangoma FreePBX contains an authentication bypass vulnerability due to insufficiently sanitized user-supplied data allows unauthenticated access to FreePBX Administrator leading to arbitrary database manipulation and remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2025-20337 — Cisco Identity Services Engine
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Cisco Identity Services Engine contains an injection vulnerability in a specific API of Cisco ISE and Cisco ISE-PIC due to insufficient validation of user-supplied input allowing an attacker to exploit this vulnerability by submitting a crafted API request. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to perform remote code execution and obtaining root privileges on an affected device.

item.title: CVE-2026-105133 — Ahsay AhsayCBS
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

item.title: CVE-2026-0322 — Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

item.title: CVE-2026-105134 — Ahsay AhsayCBS
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

item.title: CVE-2026-76519 — Cisco Secure Email Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

item.title: CVE-2023-20273 — Cisco Cisco IOS XE Web UI
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Cisco IOS XE contains a command injection vulnerability in the web user interface. When chained with CVE-2023-20198, the attacker can leverage the new local user to elevate privilege to root and write the implant to the file system. Cisco identified CVE-2023-20273 as the vulnerability exploited to deploy the implant. CVE-2021-1435, previously associated with the exploitation events, is no longer believed to be related to this activity.

item.title: CVE-2024-0769 — D-Link DIR-859 Router
item.description: Threat Signal 77. D-Link DIR-859 routers contain a path traversal vulnerability in the file /hedwig.cgi of the component HTTP POST Request Handler. Manipulation of the argument service with the input ../../../../htdocs/webinc/getcfg/DHCPS6.BRIDGE-1.xml allows for the leakage of session data potentially enabling privilege escalation and unauthorized control of the device. This vulnerability affects legacy D-Link products. All associated hardware revisions have reached their end-of-life (EOL) or end-of-service (EOS) life cycle and should be retired and replaced per vendor instructions.

item.title: CVE-2019-9874 — Sitecore CMS and Experience Platform (XP)
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Sitecore CMS and Experience Platform (XP) contain a deserialization vulnerability in the Sitecore.Security.AntiCSRF module that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code by sending a serialized .NET object in the HTTP POST parameter __CSRFTOKEN.

item.title: CVE-2024-12356 — BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS)
item.description: Threat Signal 77. BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) contain a command injection vulnerability, which can allow an unauthenticated attacker to inject commands that are run as a site user.

item.title: CVE-2024-5910 — Palo Alto Networks Expedition
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Palo Alto Networks Expedition contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker with network access to takeover an Expedition admin account and potentially access configuration secrets, credentials, and other data.

item.title: CVE-2024-28987 — SolarWinds Web Help Desk
item.description: Threat Signal 77. SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a hardcoded credential vulnerability that could allow a remote, unauthenticated user to access internal functionality and modify data.

item.title: CVE-2020-15415 — DrayTek Multiple Vigor Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 77. DrayTek Vigor3900, Vigor2960, and Vigor300B devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability in cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi/cvmcfgupload that allows for remote code execution via shell metacharacters in a filename when the text/x-python-script content type is used.

item.title: CVE-2024-28986 — SolarWinds Web Help Desk
item.description: Threat Signal 77. SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-31199 — Netwrix Auditor
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Netwrix Auditor User Activity Video Recording component contains an insecure objection deserialization vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute code as the NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM user. Successful exploitation requires that the attacker is able to reach port 9004/TCP, which is commonly blocked by standard enterprise firewalling.

item.title: CVE-2023-27992 — Zyxel Multiple Network-Attached Storage (NAS) Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Multiple Zyxel network-attached storage (NAS) devices contain a pre-authentication command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute commands remotely via a crafted HTTP request.

item.title: CVE-2020-12641 — Roundcube Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Roundcube Webmail contains an remote code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code via shell metacharacters in a configuration setting for im_convert_path or im_identify_path.

item.title: CVE-2021-3199 — ONLYOFFICE Docs
item.description: Threat Signal 71. ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-87902 — WordPress Core
item.description: Threat Signal 71. WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-39808 — Fortinet FortiSandbox
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Fortinet FortiSandbox contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted HTTP requests.

item.title: CVE-2026-45659 — Microsoft SharePoint Server
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Microsoft SharePoint Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability which allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-34910 — Ubiquiti UniFi OS
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper input validation vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to conduct command injection.

item.title: CVE-2026-48027 — Nx Nx Console
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Nx Console contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that allowed a malicious version of Nx Console to be published. The compromised extension fetched an obfuscated payload that could harvested credentials from multiple sources on disk and in memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-45321 — TanStack TanStack
item.description: Threat Signal 71. TanStack contains an unspecified vulnerability that allowed malicious versions of the product to be published to the npm registry to publish credential-stealing malware under a trusted identity.

item.title: CVE-2026-2441 — Google Chromium
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Google Chromium CSS contains a use-after-free vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2019-9621 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability via the ProxyServlet component.

item.title: CVE-2025-42999 — SAP NetWeaver
item.description: Threat Signal 71. SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer Metadata Uploader contains a deserialization vulnerability that allows a privileged attacker to compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the host system by deserializing untrusted or malicious content.

item.title: CVE-2025-30066 — tj-actions changed-files GitHub Action
item.description: Threat Signal 71. tj-actions/changed-files GitHub Action contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to discover secrets by reading Github Actions Workflow Logs. These secrets may include, but are not limited to, valid AWS access keys, GitHub personal access tokens (PATs), npm tokens, and private RSA keys.

item.title: CVE-2020-29574 — Sophos CyberoamOS
item.description: Threat Signal 71. CyberoamOS (CROS) contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the WebAdmin that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements remotely.

item.title: CVE-2018-9276 — Paessler PRTG Network Monitor
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Paessler PRTG Network Monitor contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an attacker with administrative privileges to execute commands via the PRTG System Administrator web console.

item.title: CVE-2024-11667 — Zyxel Multiple Firewalls
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Multiple Zyxel firewalls contain a path traversal vulnerability in the web management interface that could allow an attacker to download or upload files via a crafted URL.

item.title: CVE-2024-38812 — VMware vCenter Server
item.description: Threat Signal 71. VMware vCenter Server contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the implementation of the DCERPC protocol. This vulnerability could allow an attacker with network access to the vCenter Server to execute remote code by sending a specially crafted packet.

item.title: CVE-2021-26086 — Atlassian Jira Server and Data Center
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Atlassian Jira Server and Data Center contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to read particular files in the /WEB-INF/web.xml endpoint.

item.title: CVE-2024-49039 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Microsoft Windows Task Scheduler contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that can allow an attacker-provided, local application to escalate privileges outside of its AppContainer, and access privileged RPC functions.

item.title: CVE-2023-45249 — Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI)
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) allows an unauthenticated user to execute commands remotely due to the use of default passwords.

item.title: CVE-2024-20353 — Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) contain an infinite loop vulnerability that can lead to remote denial of service condition.

item.title: CVE-2018-15133 — Laravel Laravel Framework
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Laravel Framework contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability, allowing for remote command execution. This vulnerability may only be exploited if a malicious user has accessed the application encryption key (APP_KEY environment variable).

item.title: CVE-2023-23752 — Joomla! Joomla!
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Joomla! contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows unauthorized access to webservice endpoints.

item.title: CVE-2023-49103 — ownCloud ownCloud graphapi
item.description: Threat Signal 71. ownCloud graphapi contains an information disclosure vulnerability that can reveal sensitive data stored in phpinfo() via GetPhpInfo.php, including administrative credentials.

item.title: CVE-2022-26501 — Veeam Backup & Replication
item.description: Threat Signal 71. The Veeam Distribution Service in the Backup & Replication application allows unauthenticated users to access internal API functions. A remote attacker can send input to the internal API which may lead to uploading and executing of malicious code.

item.title: CVE-2021-38406 — Delta Electronics DOPSoft 2
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Delta Electronics DOPSoft 2 lacks proper validation of user-supplied data when parsing specific project files (improper input validation) resulting in an out-of-bounds write that allows for code execution.

item.title: CVE-2010-2883 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2016-7256 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 71. A remote code execution vulnerability exists when the Windows font library improperly handles specially crafted embedded fonts. An attacker who successfully exploits this vulnerability could take control of the affected system.

item.title: CVE-2015-0016 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Directory traversal vulnerability in the TS WebProxy (TSWbPrxy) component in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2016-4657 — Apple iOS
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Apple iOS WebKit contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS) via a crafted web site. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2019-11708 — Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a sandbox escape vulnerability that could result in remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-2021 — Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a vulnerability in SAML which allows an attacker to bypass authentication.

item.title: CVE-2018-0125 — Cisco VPN Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 71. A vulnerability in the web interface of the Cisco VPN Routers could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code as root and gain full control of an affected system.

item.title: CVE-2015-4068 — Arcserve Unified Data Protection (UDP)
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Directory traversal vulnerability in Arcserve UDP allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information or cause a denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2016-5195 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Race condition in mm/gup.c in the Linux kernel allows local users to escalate privileges.
